newsitem.title: USA: US Treasuries mixed at midday, long end gains.
newsitem.headline: US Treasuries mixed at midday, long end gains.

text.p: U.S. Treasury securities prices were mixed at midday on Monday with the long maturities outperforming the rest of the curve ahead of supply.
The 6-3/4 percent 30-year bond was up 6/32 to 99-18/32, yielding 6.78 percent, a touch firmer than its opening level when dollar strength against the yen contributed to small early gains.
Analysts said upcoming supply was keeping prices at the short and medium sectors of the yield curve in check.
